messages:
evan_eng: embeds-prod-eu returning intermittent 503s since 08:10 UTC. root cause looks like header parser re-entry under burst causing kvcache thrash. built quick patch image v4.0.1-hotfix. requesting expedited micro-rollout (1%) with 5m soak. need ops + sre approvals.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: service=embeds-prod-eu image=v4.0.1-hotfix requester=evan_eng default-canary=10% requested-canary=1% approvals-required=2. Approve with `/approve deploy 2789456123` or react :white_check_mark:.

lucy_sre: please attach prometheus short snapshot and confirm no migrations. prefer micro-canary 1% + 5m watch.

ovar_ops: i'll approve if rollback image posted and i'll take pager for 45m. post rollback snippet here.

evan_eng: rollback image v4.0.0-stable. no DB/config changes. rollback steps: `deployctl rollback --service embeds-prod-eu --image v4.0.0-stable && deployctl wait --stable embeds-prod-eu`. prometheus snapshot: https://telemetry/internal/snaps/2789456123-pre

isabel_pm: product approves expedited path. impact: medium for queued batch jobs in EU.

lucy_sre: /approve deploy 2789456123 — approving conditioned on 1% canary + 5m soak.

ovar_ops: /approve deploy 2789456123 — approved. pager on. rollback ready.

deploy-bot: Approvals received (2). initiating rollout: canary=1% -> observe=5m -> promote. Command: `deployctl rollout start --service embeds-prod-eu --image v4.0.1-hotfix --canary 1 --timeout 5m --requester evan_eng`. telemetry: https://telemetry/internal/embeds/2789456123-canary

deploy-bot: Canary observed after 5m: errors=0, p99 within baseline, kvcache misses normalized. promoting to 100% per policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment status: SUCCESS. release: https://deployments.redwood/2789456123

evan_eng: monitoring dashboards for 1h. will trigger rollback if any surge. thanks team.

notes-bot: Draft release note created: "hotfix(embeds): mitigate header-parser re-entry causing kv-cache thrash -> intermittent 503s (v4.0.1-hotfix)"
